description: Make an earlier release of a live R3 project the one its public URL shows again (rollback, or forward again). Only when the user asked for it. The project must be live; this never uses a plan slot. A release in the trash or one marked incomplete is refused. Nothing is deleted: the release that was live stays in the list. Take the number from r3_release_list. Needs the publish:live right.
name: r3_release_rollback

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Make an older release live
